verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI has its own LLM capabilities over crawled data: LLM-driven structured extraction, LLM table extraction, and a CLI `-q` flag that answers natural-language questions about a crawled page. That gives AI-generated answers from the user's data inside the product. It is aimed at extraction, though, not at surfacing proactive insights or suggestions. Missing for 10: explicit insight or summary generation, proactive suggestions or recommendations, documentation of how the `-q` query answers are produced, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: LLM-Driven Extraction: Supports all LLMs (open-source and proprietary) for structured data extraction.
Parse repeated patterns with CSS, XPath, or LLM-based extraction.
LLMTableExtraction: Revolutionary table extraction with intelligent chunking for massive tables
